blocks.text: Mistral Small 3 is a proprietary language model from Mistral, released on Sep 1, 2025.
At $0.1 input and $0.3 output per million tokens, it ranks #5 of 40 for input price, placing it mid-range on input cost.
Its context window of 128K tokens ranks #41 of 41 for context depth in this dataset.
Throughput is measured at 166 tokens per second (ranked #5 of 23 for throughput).
No independently verified benchmark scores are available for this model. Scores are only shown when independently confirmed with a source URL.
